#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report.pdf"
COVER_TMP = "_cover_page_tmp.pdf"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % INPUT)
        print("Workspace contents:", sorted(os.listdir(".")))
        return 1

    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
    from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    original_pages = len(PdfReader(INPUT).pages)
    print("Original page count:", original_pages)

    # 1) Build the cover page (US Letter)
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_TMP, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Cover title:", title)
    print("Cover date:", today)

    # Decorative top band
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.10, 0.20, 0.40)
    c.rect(0, height - 18, width, 18, stroke=0, fill=1)

    # Centered title and date
    c.setFillColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 30, title)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 20, today)
    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    print("Cover page written to", COVER_TMP)

    # 2) Merge: cover page first, then all original report pages
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_TMP)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    os.remove(COVER_TMP)
    print("Merged PDF written to", OUTPUT)

    # 3) Verify the result
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
    print("New page count:", len(check.pages))
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
    print("Cover page text:", first_text)
    if "Annual Financial Report" not in first_text or today not in first_text:
        print("WARNING: cover text verification failed")
        return 2
    print("OK: cover page verified on page 1")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

INPUT = "report.pdf"

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter in points

HELVETICA = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278, "-": 333,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,

    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278,
    "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333,
    "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500,
    "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
HELVETICA_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278, "-": 333,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611,
    "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611,
    "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722,
    "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333,
    "g": 611, "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278,

    "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def text_width(text, font_widths, size):
    return sum(font_widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) * size / 1000.0


def esc(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

    date_y = HEIGHT / 2.0 - 20

        "q",
        "0.10 0.20 0.40 rg",
        "0 %d %d %d re f" % (int(HEIGHT - 18), int(WIDTH), 18),
        "Q",
        "BT",
        "/F1 30 Tf",
        "0 g",
        "%.2f %.2f Td" % (title_x, title_y),

        "ET",
        "BT",
        "/F2 16 Tf",
        "%.2f %.2f Td" % (date_x, date_y),

    ]
    stream = DecodedStreamObject()

    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = stream

    f1 = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
    })
    f2 = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
    })
    fonts = DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): f1, NameObject("/F2"): f2})
    resources = DictionaryObject({NameObject("/Font"): fonts})
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources
    return writer

    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % INPUT)
        print("Workspace contents:", sorted(os.listdir(".")))
        return 1

    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
    print("Original page count:", len(report_reader.pages))

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Cover title:", title)
    print("Cover date:", today)

    cover_writer = build_cover(title, today)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_writer.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print("Merged PDF written to", OUTPUT)

    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
    print("New page count:", len(check.pages))
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
    print("Cover page text:", first_text)
    if "Annual Financial Report" not in first_text or today not in first_text:
        print("ERROR: cover text verification failed")
        return 2
    print("OK: cover page verified on page 1 of", OUTPUT)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
